channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Gold stays below $3,600 as Fed rate hike bets bets and geopolitical risks support USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) extends the range play below the $3,600 mark during the early European session on Thursday and, for now, seems to have stalled the previous day's solid bounce from its lowest level since August 2025.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Inflation risks strengthen case for BoJ hikes - Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team highlights hawkish comments from BoJ board member Tamura, who argues that the central bank must respond swiftly to signs of an inflation overshoot, potentially by accelerating rate hikes.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Holds gains above 0.6600, but broader trend stays bearish under 100-day SMA
item.description: The AUD/USD pair gathers strength to near 0.6635 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. Hotter-than-expected Australian inflation data provide some support to the Australian Dollar (AUD) against the US Dollar (USD). The US markets will be closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving.

item.title: Equities: Tech stocks pare losses as AI risks persist - Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank strategists highlight sharp intraday swings in US equities as dip-buyers helped major indices pare steep losses. Despite the Nasdaq 100's recovery, concerns over AI-related investment, debt financing and corporate governance persist, with the selloff also spreading to industrial metals.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Brief pause after vertical fall near 1.3000
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) trades marginally lower at around 1.3100 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday. The GBP/USD pair edges down as the US Dollar regains ground after a two-day corrective move.

item.title: Euro: Range-trading bias after downside pause against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank (UOB) strategists Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that EUR/USD has seen its prior weakness stabilise after breaking above strong resistance at 1.0990. Intraday, the Euro may test 1.1005 but a clear break is viewed as unlikely, with support at 1.0955/1.0940.

item.title: BoJ’s Tamura says must keep raising rates, as long as underlying inflation is around 2%
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member Naoki Tamura said on Thursday that the central bank must keep raising interest rates regardless of upside and downside price risks, as long as underlying inflation is around 2% and financial conditions remain accommodative.

item.title: Indian Rupee retreats from its eight-month high against US Dollar
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) faces some correction against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday after a sharp rally in the past few weeks. The USD/INR pair rebounds to near 92.57 from its eight-month low of 92.18 posted the previous day.

item.title: Japanese Yen holds gains as BoJ policymaker signals chance of faster-pace rate hikes
item.description: The USD/JPY pair trades with mild losses around 159.20 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) on hawkish comments from Bank of Japan (BoJ) policymakers and intervention fears.

item.title: Canadian Dollar pulls back from two-week high vs USD; rising oil prices to limit losses
item.description: The USD/CAD pair edges higher during the Asian session on Thursday, snapping a two-day losing streak to sub-1.4200 levels, or a two-week low, touched the previous day.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Softens to near 1.0950, negative tone prevails below 100-day SMA
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in negative territory near 1.0960 during the early European session on Thursday. The US Dollar (USD) edges higher against the Euro (EUR) amid hawkish expectations from the US Federal Reserve (Fed) following the hot inflation data.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Eyes move beyond $84.00 as bulls retain control above 200-hour SMA
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – touches an over one-week high during the Asian session on Thursday, with bulls now awaiting a break above the $84.00 mark before placing fresh bets.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Thursday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Softens below 174.50, bearish bias remains intact under 100-day SMA
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 174.45 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. A sell-off in AI-related tech stocks has pushed traders toward safe-haven assets, boosting the Japanese Yen (JPY) against the Euro (EUR).

item.title: United States Dollar Index rebounds to near 103.85 as AI trade recovery extends
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) strives to regain ground on Thursday after a two-day corrective move. As of writing, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, is up 0.13% to near 103.85. The DXY attracts bids after revisiting the Monday’s low at around 103.50.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar struggles to extend recovery beyond 0.5490 against US Dollar
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) struggles to extend its two-day recovery move beyond 0.5490 against US Dollar (USD) in the Asian trade on Thursday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD looks to build on recovery above $42.00
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) attracts some dip-buyers near the $40.85 area during the Asian session on Thursday, looking to build on the previous day's solid bounce from the $38.20 region, or its lowest level since August 2025.

item.title: Australian Dollar gathers strength above 0.6600 on hotter CPI inflation data
item.description: The AUD/USD pair edges higher to near an 11-month low around 0.6635 during the Asian trading hours on Thursday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) on hotter-than-expected Australian inflation data.

item.title: Japanese Yen edges higher on hawkish BoJ; modest USD uptick caps upside
item.description: The USD/JPY pair attracts fresh sellers during the Asian session on Thursday, sliding to the 159.00 mark in the last hour, though it lacks follow-through. Spot prices remain confined in a familiar range, warranting some caution before placing aggressive directional bets amid mixed cues.

item.title: British Pound steadies above 1.3100 as BoE policymakers leave December hike on the table
item.description: The GBP/USD pair flatlines near 1.3120 during the early Asian trading hours on Thursday. Traders continue to assess hawkish comments from Bank of England (BoE) policymakers and hot US inflation data. The US markets will be closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving.

item.title: BoJ’s Tamura: Focus shifts to preventing inflation overshoot and maintaining stability
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member Naoki Tamura said on Thursday that the central bank has shifted its focus from achieving 2% inflation to preventing an overshoot and maintaining stability.

item.title: Euro flat lines below 1.1000 vs USD; looks to ECB accounts for some impetus
item.description: The EUR/USD pair consolidates around the 1.0970 region during the Asian session on Thursday, stalling a modest recovery from its lowest level since April 2025, touched earlier this week.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7096 vs. 6.7088 previous
item.description: On Thursday, the People's Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7096 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7088 and 6.7088 Reuters estimate.

item.title: WTI rises above $83.50 on Middle East refinery attack
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $83.65 during the early Asian trading hours on Thursday. WTI rises amid persistent threats to energy shipments in the Middle East.

item.title: UKMTO reports an incident 50 nm west of Dubai, UAE
item.description: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency announced it received a report of an explosion that occurred on Wednesday near a tanker approximately 50 nautical miles west of Dubai, the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Reuters reported.

item.title: Gold rebounds above $3,550 as easing yields and weaker US Dollar counter hot US inflation data
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) recovers some lost ground to around $3,575 during the early Asian session on Thursday, supported by lower US Treasury yields and a weaker US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Strong US data leaves the Yen unmoved before Tokyo inflation
item.description: Stronger US data and the fastest Japanese services inflation since 1990 pulled USD/JPY in opposite directions on Wednesday, and neither won. USD/JPY has moved less than a Yen all session and is just above 159.00, where it started.

item.title: Australian Dollar falters as hot CPI collides with Fed hike bets
item.description: The Australian Dollar loses about 0.24% against the US Dollar on Wednesday as US equity markets were mixed, with tech stocks paring earlier gains following Huang's reinstatement at NVIDIA, while US economic data showed a solid economy and elevated inflation. The AUD/USD trades at 0.6626.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar rebounds from 2009 low ahead of confidence data
item.description: Ten falling sessions in a row took NZD/USD to its lowest since March 2009 on Monday, and the two sessions since have recovered about a quarter of that run. It fell to near 0.5450 on Wednesday without reaching Monday's low and is trading just under 0.5500.

item.title: Pound heads into BoE stability report flat after rate hearing
item.description: Three of the four Bank of England (BoE) rate-setters before Parliament's Treasury Committee leaned toward higher rates on Wednesday, and the Pound fell anyway. GBP/USD dropped from above 1.3100 to near 1.3050 around the US data and the hearing, then returned to just above 1.3100.
